_comment: CENR dedup fixture for feature 1025 US1 tests.
Contains 315 sites all with country_code=US so region resolution is a
no-op (all resolve to americas). Paired with cenr_dedup_missing_observations.json
which enumerates the 7 SecB2B catalogue hosts intentionally MISSING from
the CENR observation cache so the CENR-fallback code path fires once per
(site, missing-host) pair before the fix and at most 7 times per run after.
